question: What is the English name of the category 'cama_mesa_banho', and how many products does it have?
sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        ct.product_category_name_english,
        p.product_id
    FROM products p
    JOIN category_translation ct
        ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
    WHERE p.product_category_name = 'cama_mesa_banho'
)
SELECT
    MAX(product_category_name_english) AS category_name_english,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS product_count
FROM filtered
